description: Entity resolution for the raw-source graph. Each group lists graphify node IDs judged to denote the same product, service, feature, API, SDK object, concept or pattern across documents; `links` add INFERRED edges between closely related but distinct nodes. Applied by scripts/raw_graph_entity_resolution.py before the build (schema.md §11).
method: Round 1 (2026-09-24): 123 exact normalised-label groups (lowercase, parentheticals dropped) were proposed deterministically; an LLM reviewer then read all 1,839 extracted node labels (sorted, with neighbour context), confirmed or split the exact groups and added near-duplicate groups under a strict same-referent rule (renames count as the same referent; a product and its feature, a class and the pattern it implements, and exercise/answer nodes are linked, never merged).
